cards.title: Fly to the Oso Bridge
cards.mapFocus: (KNGP) Corpus Christi NAS/Oso Transition / South Arrivals & Departures/Oso Bridge (West Side)
instructions: Climb to 1,000' MSL · accelerate to 200 KIAS
Proceed direct to the western edge of the Oso Bridge
cards.detail: The Oso Transition is quicker and uses less fuel, but needs advance notice to Waldron Tower and Tower approval.
cards.source: Binder, pp. 25–26; Feb 2026 PPT, Part 2, slides 63–67.
